subject: CRITICAL BUG: WebSocket sync disconnects repeatedly with ERR_WS_DISCONNECTED_502
body: Across our entire engineering department (35 users), board columns are freezing and failing to sync. The browser console is flooded with WebSocket connection to wss://sync.flowboard.app/v2/boards failed: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway. Hard refreshes and clearing IndexedDB do not resolve the issue. Team members are overwriting each other work.
